summary: Implemented a GitHubConnector class to retrieve organization members via the GitHub REST API, adhering to the existing integration contract and using only standard library facilities.
changes: CREATE src/integrations/github.py: Implemented GitHubConnector with support for organization membership retrieval, pagination, and error handling.
CREATE tests/test_github.py: Added comprehensive unit tests using mocked HTTP responses to verify functionality, error handling, and pagination.
MODIFY src/integrations/__init__.py: Updated package exports to include the new GitHubConnector.
testing_summary: The implementation was validated using a suite of 14 pytest unit tests, covering successful data retrieval, pagination logic, HTTP error handling (4xx/5xx), timeout enforcement, and input validation. All tests were executed in an isolated environment using mocked network calls. Baseline tests for existing components were also verified to ensure no regressions.
limitations: The connector relies on the GitHub API's visibility rules; it only retrieves members visible to the provided token.
The implementation does not support authentication methods other than Bearer tokens.
The connector is limited to the public members endpoint and does not support advanced filtering or private member discovery beyond what the API provides.
review_notes: The implementation uses standard library urllib.request exclusively, satisfying the no-runtime-dependency requirement.
The constructor performs strict validation on organization and token inputs.
The pagination logic correctly parses the 'Link' header as per GitHub API specifications.
Error handling explicitly catches and re-raises HTTP and transport errors to prevent partial data returns.
Reviewers should verify that the mock implementation in tests/test_github.py accurately reflects the expected behavior of the standard library's context manager.
